sources.title: Introducing the First AMD 1B Language Models: AMD OLMo
sources.snippet: AMD is releasing its first open source 1B language model, advancing accessible AI with high-performance AMD Instinct™ GPUs and Ryzen™ AI PCs.

sources.title: Introducing the First AMD 1B Language Models: AMD OLMo
sources.snippet: The language model was also deployed onto AMD Ryzen AI PCs that can potentially help enable a diverse set of edge use cases. Open sourcing the data, weights, training recipes and code is primarily aimed at helping developers to reproduce as well as innovate further on top.

sources.title: Introducing the First AMD 1B Language Models: AMD OLMo
sources.snippet: Aligned with the goal of advancing accessible AI research, AMD has open-sourced its complete training details and released the checkpoints for the first series of AMD OLMo models. This initiative empowers a diverse community of users, developers, and researchers to explore, utilize, and train state-of-the-art large language models.
